ranked.text: Upstream demand telemetry from grid-telemetry stopped or degraded below all four load zones, causing ingestion demand freshness to reach the 10-minute stale threshold.
The ingestion service's demand batch path stalled or became unusually slow, so the newest demand reading did not advance despite the absence of demand batch errors.
A contract violation in demand payloads from grid-telemetry caused ingestion to reject demand records and stop advancing its latest demand reading.
A recent ingestion rollout or configuration change altered the demand ingestion path and caused the demand input to stop advancing.
